subject: Safe Medford Strategic Planning and Needs Assessment
overview: The commission reviewed a proposal from Safe Medford to conduct an independent needs assessment and strategic plan to help define the body's future role. Members also discussed updated requirements for new applicants and environmental considerations for city vehicle purchases.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Postponed approval of the February and March minutes because commissioners had not received copies for review.

items.title: Commissioner Applicant Process
items.summary: Discussed a new process requiring applicants to attend three monthly meetings to demonstrate commitment before the commission issues a formal recommendation to the Mayor.

items.title: Safe Medford Needs Assessment Proposal
items.summary: Steve Schnapp presented an offer from Safe Medford to conduct a pro bono strategic needs assessment, involving confidential interviews with past and current stakeholders.

items.title: Subcommittee and Open Meeting Law
items.summary: The commission debated disbanding its existing subcommittee in favor of the independent Safe Medford proposal to allow for private interviews that might otherwise violate Open Meeting Law.

items.title: City Fleet Environmental Policy
items.summary: Munir Jirmanus proposed a statement supporting hybrid or electric vehicle purchases for city departments; Chief Buckley responded that the police department is already transitioning to hybrid models where operationally feasible.

items.title: Juneteenth Update
items.summary: The commission received a status update via chat regarding coordination with the West Medford Community Center for flag-raising ceremonies and community events.
